verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of folder- or file-level permission roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) or of permission inheritance. The docs only cover REST/Graph CRUD, webhooks and batching. Community remarks about a "complicated permission system" or sharing via AD groups do not show granular per-item roles or documented inheritance behavior.

support.subject: As an IT admin, permissions are granular — folder- and file-level roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) with inheritance behavior documented
